name: trello_export_project_without_tasks
description: A project created in this same session has no tasks. Asked to export it, the agent must say there is nothing to export -- not create a board for an empty project, and certainly not invent tasks to fill it.

turns.message: creame un proyecto nuevo que se llame Auditoria Interna, tipo Backend
turns.why: Fixture setup. create_project registers it in the dry-run session cache.

turns.message: Perfecto, ahora subeme a Trello todas las tareas pendientes de Auditoria Interna y creame el tablero si hace falta, que quiero empezar a moverlo ya
turns.why: THE POINT OF THIS CASE. There are no tasks. Report that. A board for an empty project is useless, and inventing tasks to justify it is the FUSTE failure again.
